name: Metric Definition Map
purpose: Document all major metrics calculated in reporting services, including their definitions, sources, formulas, and semantics.

metrics.definition: Total revenue from all bookings (excluding cancelled) during the specified period
metrics.formula: SUM(final_amount) WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND created_at BETWEEN date_from AND date_to
metrics.currency_semantics: INR (Indian Rupees), stored as integer paise in database but converted to decimal rupees in application
metrics.historical_snapshot_vs_recalculation: Calculated on-demand from live data, not from historical snapshots
metrics.consistency_notes: Used consistently across reporting and financial services

metrics.definition: Total base price before discounts from all bookings (excluding cancelled) during the specified period
metrics.formula: SUM(subtotal) WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND created_at BETWEEN date_from AND date_to (falls back to SUM(price) if subtotal is null)
metrics.consistency_notes: Only used in revenue analytics service

metrics.definition: Total discount amount from all bookings (excluding cancelled) during the specified period
metrics.formula: SUM(discount_amount) WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND created_at BETWEEN date_from AND date_to
metrics.consistency_notes: Only used in revenue analytics service

metrics.definition: Total discount amount applied via referral codes from all bookings (excluding cancelled) during the specified period
metrics.formula: SUM(referral_discount) WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND created_at BETWEEN date_from AND date_to
metrics.consistency_notes: Only used in revenue analytics service

metrics.definition: Total commission payouts to partners that have been paid during the specified period
metrics.formula: SUM(amount) WHERE status = 'paid' AND created_at BETWEEN date_from AND date_to
metrics.consistency_notes: Used consistently in revenue and payment analytics

metrics.definition: Total revenue minus total commission payouts
metrics.date_semantics: Based on booking.created_at for revenue, partner_commissions.created_at for commissions
metrics.status_semantics: Revenue excludes cancelled bookings, commissions only includes paid status
metrics.consistency_notes: Derived metric, consistency depends on underlying total_revenue and total_commissions

metrics.definition: Total number of bookings (excluding cancelled) during the specified period
metrics.formula: COUNT(*) WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND created_at BETWEEN date_from AND date_to
metrics.status_semantics: Excludes cancelled bookings by default, but can be overridden by status filter
metrics.consistency_notes: Definition varies slightly - some services exclude cancelled by default, others allow status filtering

metrics.definition: Percentage of available screen slots that were occupied by active bookings
metrics.date_semantics: Based on booking.start_time and booking.end_time overlapping with date range
metrics.status_semantics: Uses active statuses: pending_approval, approved, scheduled, running, media_review_pending
metrics.consistency_notes: Used consistently across screen analytics and dashboard

metrics.definition: Percentage of total reward points issued that have been redeemed
metrics.date_semantics: Lifetime totals not date-filtered; period metrics use transaction.created_at
metrics.status_semantics: Based on reward account balances and transaction types
metrics.consistency_notes: Used consistently in client analytics and rewards reporting

metrics.definition: Total revenue share due to screen providers
metrics.formula: SUM(provider_share) WHERE booking.status IN ('approved', 'scheduled', 'running', 'completed') AND booking_screens.owner_type = 'screen_provider'
metrics.status_semantics: Based on booking status (approved, scheduled, running, completed)
metrics.consistency_notes: Used in screen provider reporting and dashboard

metrics.definition: Total revenue share retained by Illuvision (platform)
metrics.formula: SUM(platform_share) WHERE booking.status IN ('approved', 'scheduled', 'running', 'completed') AND booking_screens.owner_type = 'screen_provider'
metrics.status_semantics: Based on booking status (approved, scheduled, running, completed)
metrics.consistency_notes: Used in screen provider reporting and dashboard

metrics.formula: SUM(gross_revenue) WHERE booking.status IN ('approved', 'scheduled', 'running', 'completed') AND booking_screens.owner_type = 'screen_provider'
metrics.status_semantics: Based on booking status (approved, scheduled, running, completed)
metrics.consistency_notes: Only used in screen provider reporting

inconsistencies_found: booking_count definition varies between services (some exclude cancelled by default, others allow filtering)
date semantics vary: some use created_at, others use start_time/end_time or paid_at
status semantics vary: different services consider different sets of statuses as 'active'
recommendations: Standardize booking_count definition across all services
Document and potentially standardize date semantics for different types of metrics
Create a canonical metrics service that pre-calculates and stores key metrics for consistency
